rationale: C22 is an earlier executive order with the same distinctive title and therefore almost certainly uses the same specific legal mechanism: suspending limitations upon punishments for violations of military articles. That match is far more concrete than a shared topic and plausibly supplied both the operative structure and language for the later directive. C10 and C08 are the next strongest because they prescribe the governing courts-martial manuals and expressly address maximum-punishment limitations, but they are less direct templates for a suspension order.
